title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - AiContract
description: An Ai Contract represents a contract or arrangement, either written or verbal and sometimes enforceable by law, such as a service level agreement or a customer price agreement. An agreement involves a number of other business entities, such as products, services, and resources and/or their specifications. (TM Forum TMF915 Ai Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition AiContract; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)
